system.description: While you are in contact with a source of liquid such as puddles, flooded halls, sewers, you gain tremor sense based on that liquid up to 1 mile away. In addition, conversations had near the body of water can be heard by you. You can only focus on one location at a time and thus cannot perceive all conversations had near a body of water.
